name: Do sliding windows require specific maintenance?

mainEntity.name: Do sliding windows require specific maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sliding windows generally require minimal maintenance. Regular cleaning of the glass and frames, along with occasional lubrication of the tracks, helps ensure smooth operation. It's also important to keep the tracks clear of debris to prevent operational issues. Customers should note that proper track maintenance is key to preventing wear and tear on the moving parts, which can extend the lifespan of the window.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sliding windows need regular cleaning of glass and frames, and occasional track lubrication to ensure smooth operation.
